title: Prompt (the message an inferring call sends to an LLM model)
description: The outgoing message inferring sends to an llm-model. A prompt IS a claim — a JSON Schema 2020-12 document — commonly the most-specific type {const: <HTML SHP / text>} carrying the literal message to send (HTML is the inter-LLM format). inferring unpacks the prompt's content into the endpoint request body and packs the reply back as the claim of the produced utterance. The prompt-vs-reply distinction is positional in the produced utterance: the prompt is recorded in the call-provenance token (slot 0), the reply is the claim (slot 1).
